title: "Public corporation" defined.
bodyText: As used in this chapter, "public corporation" means the State of Hawaii, any political subdivision thereof, and municipality therein, or any public agency of the State.
bodyHtml: §212-2  "Public corporation" defined.  As used in this chapter, "public corporation" means the State of Hawaii, any political subdivision thereof, and municipality therein, or any public agency of the State. [L 1963, c 7, §3; Supp, §98T-3; HRS §212-2]
